idea: How to prevent bathroom pipe problems
title: Simple Habits for Healthy Bathroom Pipes
description: A few simple habits can save you from unexpected bathroom plumbing issues. Start by using drain catchers in your sink and shower to trap hair and soap scum before they cause stubborn clogs. Never flush items like wipes, paper towels, or dental floss, even if the packaging claims they are flushable. Periodically check under your sink for small drips, moisture, or signs of corrosion on exposed pipes, as catching minor leaks early prevents major water damage. If you notice slow drains, unusual noises, or persistent leaks, it is best to schedule a professional inspection to keep your plumbing system running smoothly.
